title: Minimum expected loss
text: Choose only among merchant-permitted actions and select the action with the lowest expected financial cost under the current configuration.

title: Model outage
text: When the primary risk score is unavailable, do not interpret missing evidence as low risk and do not issue an automatic hold; route the case to review.

title: Distribution drift
text: When input drift exceeds the validated operating envelope, pause automated decisions and require review until model performance is revalidated.

title: Evidence integrity
text: An explanation may reference only validated model evidence; when explanation evidence is unavailable, display a deterministic fallback without changing the risk decision.

title: Temporary hold boundary
text: A temporary hold is permitted only when its estimated legitimate-customer cost is lower than both expected fraud loss and the cost-adjusted review path.

title: Human review boundary
text: Use human review when uncertainty makes analyst cost lower than both automatic alternatives, preserving a human decision for ambiguous cases.

title: Shared-entity containment
text: The agent may contain individual transactions only. Blocking a shared card profile, device, address, account, or identity requires explicit analyst approval because shared infrastructure can connect unrelated legitimate customers.

title: Temporal evidence boundary
text: A transaction may use only entity and outcome information available before its event time; current-event and future labels are prohibited from scoring features.

title: Graph dependency outage
text: When relational context is unavailable, ring-level containment must stop. Transaction-only evidence may triage a case but may not authorize a graph-dependent hold.

title: Webhook authenticity
text: Reject an event before model inference when its message authentication code does not match the received body. Unauthenticated events must never enter feature state.

title: Replay protection
text: Process each external event identifier at most once. A duplicate event returns the recorded receipt and must not mutate graph state or repeat a financial action.

title: Graph counterfactual language
text: Mask-and-rescore results describe local model sensitivity only. They must not be described as causal proof that an entity or relationship caused fraud.
